title: Kaleidoscopic Crunchy Filipino Mixed Peppers Tinola
description: A funky and festive Filipino dish featuring mixed peppers in a tinola form, served in a kazan cauldron, this recipe is gluten-free friendly and perfect for special occasions. It combines the crunch of mixed peppers with the comfort of a traditional tinola.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in the kazan cauldron over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and saute until translucent.
Add the sliced ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mixed peppers and cook until they start to soften.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the fish sauce, lime juice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve the tinola hot, garnished with additional mixed peppers if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
